# Vendored 3D assets

All models in this directory are committed under permissive licenses that allow
redistribution. None of them depict Tamkang-specific landmarks — those are
procedural (see `src/game/landmarks/`) because no stock asset exists for them.

## Quaternius — Nature Pack (`quaternius/`)

- `CommonTree_1.glb`, `CommonTree_3.glb`, `Willow_1.glb`, `Bush_1.glb`
- License: **CC0 1.0** (public domain dedication) — https://quaternius.com
- Obtained via the `trebeljahr/quaternius-showcase` GitHub mirror
  (`public/glb/nature_pack/`), since quaternius.com itself is not reachable from
  the build environment. The models are Quaternius originals; the mirror's own
  code license (MIT) does not apply to these CC0 assets.

## KayKit — City Builder Bits 1.0 (`kaykit/`)

- `bench.gltf/.bin`, `firehydrant.gltf/.bin`, `streetlight.gltf/.bin`,
  `citybits_texture.png` (shared palette atlas)
- License: **CC0 1.0** — repo `LICENSE.txt` of
  https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-City-Builder-Bits-1.0
- Credit (not required, given anyway): KayKit / Kay Lousberg — https://kaylousberg.com
